opportunities.name: Book unit note: Gutenberg + IMDb to notes
opportunities.description: For a given book title, get author and download count from Project Gutenberg, find the film adaptation's year and rating on IMDb, and save a 'Unit:' note.
steps: Search the book title on Project Gutenberg
Open the matching book result and read author and download count
Search the same title on IMDb
Open the matching film and read year and rating
Add a new note 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>'

opportunities.name: Country geography note: Wikipedia + timeanddate to notes
opportunities.description: For a country, look up facts on Wikipedia, find the capital's current time on timeanddate, and save a 'Geography:' note.
steps: Search the country on Wikipedia and read capital, population, languages, currency
Search the capital on timeanddate and open the result to read current time
Add a new note 'Geography: <country>, capital <capital>, pop <pop>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time>'
